roadmap.title: Banished Hero
roadmap.description: Start a fresh save on Expert and keep that setting through the first ending. Avoid golden Spirit of Advocacy summons throughout the journey. Complete Banished Hero and collect its Soulstones.

roadmap.title: Trials of the Frozen Mountain
roadmap.description: Complete Trials of the Frozen Mountain; collect nearby Soulstones and revisit available bonus missions.

roadmap.title: Forgotten Temple
roadmap.description: Complete Forgotten Temple; collect nearby Soulstones and revisit available bonus missions.

roadmap.title: Devoured Village

roadmap.description: Complete Witch's Castle; collect nearby Soulstones and revisit available bonus missions.

roadmap.title: Master of Chaos cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish collectibles before the final fight. Keep mission replay available until all cleanup is complete.

roadmap.title: Endings and finale reload
roadmap.description: Keep Expert active and avoid golden helper summons. Back up at Corrupted Lounge, finish the true ending, then restore and lower difficulty for the other ending if needed.

roadmap.title: Start the second journey
roadmap.description: After every other achievement, begin New Game+ with Blade Phantom.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Yetuga} at the end of @loc{Banished Hero}.
Defeat @enemy{Blade Phantom} at the end of @loc{Trials of the Frozen Mountain}.
Defeat @enemy{Viper} at the end of @loc{Forgotten Temple}.
Defeat @enemy{Volbaino} at the end of @loc{First Act of Revenge}.
Defeat @enemy{Aratra} at the end of @loc{Strange Stench}.
Defeat @enemy{Rangkus} at the end of @loc{Traitor Revealed}.
Defeat @enemy{Maluca} at the end of @loc{Veiled Knives}.
Defeat @enemy{Elamein} at the end of @loc{Devoured Village}.
Defeat @enemy{Shactuka} at the end of @loc{Inconceivable Truth}.
Defeat @enemy{Trokka} at the end of @loc{Witch's Castle}.
Defeat @enemy{Bellerian} at the end of @loc{Hermit Mountains}.
Defeat @enemy{Skalpel} at the end of @loc{Corruptors' Fortress}.
Defeat @enemy{Princess Ilyna} at the end of @loc{Strange Melody}.
Defeat @enemy{Hismar} at the end of @loc{Fall of the Empire}.
Defeat @enemy{Reese} at the end of @loc{Bloodied Sanctuary}.

achievements.description: Finish the Centurial Order bonus mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Centurial Order bonus mission.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Strange Melody} to unlock @loc{Centurial Order}.
Finish Centurial Order by defeating @enemy{The Ninety-Ninth Owl} and watching the closing scene.

If the achievement stays locked after completing the mission chain, replay all 24 bonus missions without closing the game. Use their last unlocked Blade Nexus to repeat the final encounter; finish Jar Enthusiasts by finding its six Jarlings again.

achievements.description: Complete the Birth of Evil bonus mission.
achievements.summary: Complete the Birth of Evil bonus mission.

steps.text: Ask Yulian for @loc{Birth of Evil} once @loc{Fall of the Empire} is finished.
Defeat @enemy{Gilsan} and the two Knivesveil Marksmen, then speak to Seona.

achievements.description: Complete the Remnants of Chaos bonus mission.
achievements.summary: Complete the Remnants of Chaos bonus mission.

steps.text: Ask Tristan for @loc{Remnants of Chaos} once @loc{Strange Melody} is finished.
Use the purple portals and laboratory levers to reach @loc{Laboratory No. 3}. Defeat @enemy{Tanya} beyond the double doors, then speak to Tristan.

If the achievement stays locked after completing the mission chain, replay all 24 bonus missions without closing the game. Use their last unlocked Blade Nexus to repeat the final encounter; finish Jar Enthusiasts by finding its six Jarlings again.

achievements.description: Finish Last Command and rescue the three prisoners.
achievements.summary: Finish the Last Command bonus mission.

steps.text: Ask Yulian for @loc{Escaping Linon Mine} once @loc{Inconceivable Truth} is finished. Completing that bonus mission opens @loc{Last Command}.
In Last Command, release the three caged prisoners, defeat their captors, and speak to Adrick and Yulian.

achievements.description: Complete The Vow and uncover Reese's history.

steps.text: In @loc{Witch's Castle}, reach Aldevir Citadel and take the narrow alley right of the large door. Pick up @item{Aldevir's Disk Fragment}.
In @loc{Corruptors' Fortress}, enter the castle at Vampire Gate. Pick up @item{Vaisar's Disk Fragment} from the alcove on the left wall.

In @loc{Strange Melody}, collect the @item{Grand Theater Key}, then break the false wall on your right. Open the gate leading out of the hidden hallway and pick up @item{Rovelion's Disk Fragment} just beyond it.
After @loc{Fall of the Empire}, speak to Daphrona with the three fragments to accept @loc{The Vow}.
Defeat @enemy{Specter of Pleuvious} in The Vow, then read the journal in the chapel.

achievements.description: Obtain Charon's Chains by completing the matching bonus mission.
achievements.summary: Complete the Charon's Chains bonus mission.

steps.text: After @loc{Fall of the Empire}, enter @loc{Charon's Chains}.
At Where Despair Echoes, defeat @enemy{Granite Jocko}, @enemy{Tigron}, and @enemy{Netherworld Aratra} in sequence to finish the mission.

achievements.description: Finish the Transcendental Sword bonus mission.
achievements.summary: Finish the Transcendental Sword bonus mission.

steps.text: After @loc{Corruptors' Fortress}, accept @loc{Transcendental Sword} from Blade Phantom.
At the sword, overcome @enemy{Remnant of Elamein}. Finish by talking with Daphrona.

achievements.description: Complete Final Conquest and bring peace to Xilence.
achievements.summary: Finish the Final Conquest bonus mission.

steps.text: After @loc{Veiled Knives}, accept and complete Oksana's @loc{Human Xilence} mission to unlock @loc{Final Conquest}.
Defeat @enemy{Mutated Xilence} in Final Conquest and finish the scene.

achievements.description: Finish Unrequited Love and Disobedience to resolve Yulian and Tristan's story.
achievements.summary: Complete both Unrequited Love and Disobedience.

steps.text: After @loc{Witch's Castle}, accept @loc{Unrequited Love} from Tristan. Defeat Gwydo, examine the coffin, and speak to Tristan.
After @loc{Fall of the Empire}, complete @loc{Disobedience} by defeating Cursed Boris and speaking to Yulian.

If the achievement stays locked after completing the mission chain, replay all 24 bonus missions without closing the game. Use their last unlocked Blade Nexus to repeat the final encounter; finish Jar Enthusiasts by finding its six Jarlings again.
Drain an enemy's stamina until a red marker appears on its chest, then use @mechanic{Brutal Attack}.

achievements.description: Formed a pact with Blade Phantom.
achievements.summary: Make the pact with Blade Phantom.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Veiled Knives} and accept the pact during the following story sequence.

achievements.description: Defeated an enemy using a breakfall.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a breakfall attack.

steps.text: Drop from a ledge above an enemy and attack in midair; the breakfall must kill the enemy.
After the Javelin tutorial in @loc{Trials of the Frozen Mountain}, defeat enemies to fill a Spirit diamond, then aim and throw a @mechanic{Javelin}.

achievements.description: Retrieved Lacrima using the power of the ghost.
achievements.summary: Reclaim the Lacrima left at your death location.

steps.text: After dying with Lacrima, return to your @mechanic{Soul Tear} and recover the dropped Lacrima.

achievements.summary: Craft one piece of gear through Qazumaka.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Strange Stench}, then visit the Realm of the Living. Qazumaka offers @loc{Blacksmith's Heirloom}; complete this bonus mission.
Give Qazumaka a gear scroll, then craft a gear piece whose displayed materials and gold cost you can pay.

achievements.summary: Dismantle one piece of gear through Qazumaka.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Blacksmith's Heirloom}, accepted from Qazumaka after @loc{Strange Stench}, then have him dismantle an unwanted gear piece.

achievements.summary: Change one gear attribute through Oksana.

steps.text: After @loc{Traitor Revealed}, accept @loc{Kaleido} from Oksana and complete it.
Return to Oksana in @loc{The Crevice}, choose @mechanic{Alter Attributes}, and pay to change an attribute on a gear piece.

achievements.summary: Extract Lacrima from one gear piece through Oksana.

steps.text: In @loc{The Crevice}, ask Oksana to extract Lacrima from an unwanted weapon or armor piece.

achievements.summary: Increase one character stat with Lacrima.

steps.text: Spend Lacrima on a stat at a @loc{Blade Nexus}.
Complete Oksana's @loc{Kaleido} bonus mission after @loc{Traitor Revealed}.
Choose @mechanic{Augment Gear} at Oksana and spend a compatible donor item and the displayed gold cost to upgrade your selected gear.
Finish @loc{Forgotten Temple}, then visit the Realm of the Living in @loc{The Crevice}. Purchase any item at Duimuk's shop.
Finish @loc{Forgotten Temple}, then visit the Realm of the Living in @loc{The Crevice}. Use Duimuk's shop to sell an unwanted item.

achievements.description: Woke a dormant ghost from its slumber.
achievements.summary: Equip a Phantom for the first time.

steps.text: Accept @loc{Stormpass' Phantom of Combat} from Blade Phantom on arriving in The Crevice and complete it.
Equip the unlocked Phantom at a @loc{Blade Nexus} in The Crevice.

achievements.description: Upgraded abilities by unleashing the power of Soulstones.
achievements.summary: Purchase one ability upgrade with Soulstones.

steps.text: Break red @item{Soulstones}. Once Forgotten Temple is complete, climb The Crevice's central stairs and purchase an upgrade from Daphrona.
After @loc{First Act of Revenge}, accept @loc{Jar Enthusiasts} from Duimuk.
Start the mission at @loc{Cradle of Jars} and break the jar blocking the bridge beyond Jar Observatory.
Spend the free skill point given at @loc{Snowfield of Trials} in Trials of the Frozen Mountain.

achievements.description: Used a consumable for the first time.

steps.text: Use @item{Netherworld Energy} to heal after taking damage.
In @loc{Forgotten Temple}, take the right branch in the field beyond Corner Leading to the Abandoned Plains and collect the @item{Vitality Tome} at the dead end.
Collect the @item{Vitality Tome} along the right branch beyond the first Blade Nexus in Forgotten Temple.
Complete @loc{Blacksmith's Heirloom} after Strange Stench and give the tome to Qazumaka.
Craft a @item{Vitality Sphere} with 3 Transmutation Shards and 200 gold. Duimuk sells the shards for 100 gold each.
Defeat the first Imperial soldier in @loc{Banished Hero} and collect the @item{Escort Order}.

achievements.description: Summoned a wandering soul of the rift.
achievements.summary: Summon a Revenant of Adversity or a Spirit of Advocacy.

guide.context: Golden Spirit of Advocacy summons invalidate Standing Alone; red hostile summons do not.

steps.text: When summons become available in @loc{Forgotten Temple}, activate a red @enemy{Revenant of Adversity} summon point.

achievements.description: Equipped a piece of gear in every slot.
achievements.summary: Equip gear in all eight equipment slots at once.

steps.text: Equip a weapon, helm, top, gauntlets, pants, shoes, necklace, and ring together.

For fixed accessory pickups, take Necklace of Sealed Plague from the cell opened with the wheel before the boss in Why Have You Forsaken Us? In The Vow's chapel, collect the altar's Reese's Ring before you read the journal.

achievements.summary: Begin New Game+ after completing the story.

guide.context: Starting New Game+ closes mission replay for the current journey until those missions are unlocked again.

steps.text: Finish your ending and select the option to continue your current journey while you clear any unfinished missions or collectibles.
When cleanup is complete, speak to Blade Phantom in @loc{The Crevice} and begin the second journey.

achievements.description: Meet the Bard at all five mission locations to uncover Digor's past.
achievements.summary: Speak to the Bard at all five mission locations.

guide.context: If a meeting was skipped, replay that mission before starting New Game+.

steps.text: Near Forgotten Temple Entrance in @loc{Forgotten Temple}, find the Netherworld Energy upgrade and speak with the Bard nearby.
In @loc{Strange Stench}, talk to him on the ledge with Blacksmith Union Permit near Poisoned Depths.
In @loc{Hermit Mountains}, take the right route from Hermit's Cave and descend the ladder to his room.
In @loc{Strange Melody}, break the left wall in the hallway before the staircase to the bridge beyond Banquet Hall Entrance. Use the revealed painting to reach his piano room.
In @loc{Fall of the Empire}, follow the route from New Town to the room with an outside exit on the left. Open the right-hand door to find him.

guide.context: After First Act of Revenge, accept Jar Enthusiasts from Duimuk. Completing that mission activates Jarlings elsewhere; revisit the first four main missions afterward. Missing Jarlings remain available through mission replay before New Game+.

achievements.description: Reached the ending without summoning a Spirit of Advocacy.
achievements.summary: Finish the story having summoned no Spirit of Advocacy.

steps.text: On a fresh save, leave golden @mechanic{Spirit of Advocacy} summon points unused for the whole journey. Red Revenants of Adversity do not invalidate the achievement.
Defeat Ozma and finish the ending. If you used a golden helper, a conservative fallback is a new save without helpers, or a backup made before the first helper summon.

achievements.summary: Finish the story on Beginner or Normal difficulty.

steps.text: Check Steam after completing the Expert ending. If this achievement is still locked, restore your Corrupted Lounge save backup with the game closed and Steam Cloud disabled.
Return to @loc{The Crevice}, lower the difficulty to Normal or Beginner, and replay the final encounter in @loc{Master of Chaos}. Complete the ending sequence.
After loading and saving your desired local progress, re-enable Steam Cloud.

achievements.description: Reached the ending after a difficult journey.
achievements.summary: Finish the story on Expert difficulty.

steps.text: Start a new save on @mechanic{Expert} and keep that difficulty for the whole journey.

At Corrupted Lounge in Master of Chaos, quit after the autosave, close the game, and copy %LOCALAPPDATA%\The First Berserker Khazan\Saved\SaveGames into your backup folder. Keep this backup until both difficulty-ending achievements unlock. Disable Steam Cloud before restoring it so the local backup is not replaced.
Defeat Ozma and finish the ending sequence on Expert before lowering the difficulty.

guide.context: A two-phase Ozma fight means the true-ending route is inactive. Without a backup made before the final choice, a failed ending route requires another journey.

steps.text: Collect all 15 golden records for @mechanic{Ozma's Past} and finish all 24 bonus missions before the finale.

At Corrupted Lounge in Master of Chaos, quit after the autosave, close the game, and copy %LOCALAPPDATA%\The First Berserker Khazan\Saved\SaveGames into your backup folder. Keep this backup until both difficulty-ending achievements unlock. Disable Steam Cloud before restoring it so the local backup is not replaced.
At @loc{Corrupted Lounge} in Master of Chaos, speak to Daphrona and select @mechanic{I must know the truth}.
Defeat all three phases of @enemy{Ozma}.
Follow the memory-room interactions until the diary appears. Close the diary without opening any entries, then examine the portrait and finish the scene.
If the ending does not unlock, restore the Corrupted Lounge backup and repeat the dialogue and finale.
